steps.text: Sit at a table with your forearm resting on it and make a gentle fist.
Spread your fingers as wide as is comfortable.
Close your hand slowly into a gentle fist again.

safety: Stop if it hurts or tingles.

mistakes.label: not_closed
mistakes.wrong: your hand did not close into a fist between openings
mistakes.right: Between openings, close your hand into a gentle fist.

mistakes.label: fingers_not_spread
mistakes.wrong: your fingers stayed close together when your hand opened
mistakes.right: Spread your fingers wide as you open your hand, only as far as is comfortable.
